specs.name: outline-format.md
specs.title: Outline format (outline/v1)
specs.description: How to write a Word outline the site turns into headings, callouts and case cards, and that the reference popup indexes (sections, case keys, worked problems).

specs.name: supplement-format.md
specs.title: Statutory / rule supplement format (supplement/v1)
specs.description: The AREAS and DATA contract behind a course supplement and the reference popup, and the citation styles (ucc, fre, mrpc, frcp, restatement, section).

specs.name: mcq-format.md
specs.title: MCQ practice set format (mcq/v1)
specs.description: The canonical multiple-choice schema, the Shuffle-mode practice page it builds into, and the citation rules that make every question link to the supplement and outline.

specs.name: cards-format.md
specs.title: Flashcard deck format (cards/v1)
specs.description: The canonical flashcard schema and the study page it builds into: one card at a time, shuffle, remove, and an all-cards overview.

specs.name: ai-prompts.md
specs.title: Prompt templates
specs.description: Copy-paste prompts for generating an outline, a supplement, a practice set and a flashcard deck in these formats.

specs.name: mcq-shuffle-template.html
specs.title: MCQ practice page template
specs.description: The standalone Shuffle-mode practice page with a sample mcq/v1 set; replace the JSON in its mcq-data block.

specs.name: supplement-template.html
specs.title: Supplement viewer template
specs.description: The standalone supplement viewer with sample UCC data; replace its SUPP, AREAS and DATA lines.

specs.name: cards-template.html
specs.title: Flashcard page template
specs.description: The standalone flashcard page with a sample cards/v1 deck; replace the JSON in its cards-data block.
